# Generated by "Claude files/tools/build_lizardfolk_hall.py" from lizardfolk_data.py. Change the tables there and re-run.

# The Hall of Recitation (doc 70). Plain ifs only: no else in these effects (Claude files/35).

# The canon: remember an empire, forget it (Strike from the Canon). Its tiles' bonuses follow (doc 70, 9.2).
DA_LZ_remember.e1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_mem.e1 } }
		custom_tooltip = DA_LZ_remember_tt.e1
		hidden_effect = {
			set_country_flag = DA_LZ_mem.e1
			set_country_flag = DA_LZ_new.e1
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.LZ_One1 NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_RH_done.lizardfolk.LZ_One1 } }
				DA_RH_grant_lizardfolk_LZ_One1 = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.LZ_One3 NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_RH_done.lizardfolk.LZ_One3 } }
				DA_RH_grant_lizardfolk_LZ_One3 = yes
			}
			DA_LZ_refresh = yes
		}
	}
}
DA_LZ_forget.e1 = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_LZ_forget_tt.e1
	hidden_effect = {
		clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_mem.e1
		clr_country_flag = DA_RH_done.lizardfolk.LZ_One1
		remove_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_LZ_One1
		clr_country_flag = DA_RH_done.lizardfolk.LZ_One3

# An empire not yet remembered, at random: only from hidden events (no dice in a button)
DA_LZ_remember_random = {
	DA_LZ_clear_new = yes
	if = {
		limit = { DA_LZ_can_remember = yes }
		random_list = {
			10 = {
				modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_LZ_mem.e1 }
				DA_LZ_remember.e1 = yes
			}
			10 = {
				modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_LZ_mem.e2 }
				DA_LZ_remember.e2 = yes
			}
			10 = {
				modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_LZ_mem.e116 }
				DA_LZ_remember.e116 = yes
			}
			10 = {
				modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_LZ_mem.e118 }
				DA_LZ_remember.e118 = yes
			}
			10 = {
				modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_LZ_mem.tchoken }
				DA_LZ_remember.tchoken = yes
			}
			10 = {
				modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_LZ_mem.genie }
				DA_LZ_remember.genie = yes
			}
			10 = {
				modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_LZ_mem.e223 }
				DA_LZ_remember.e223 = yes
			}
			10 = {
				modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_LZ_mem.e271 }
				DA_LZ_remember.e271 = yes
			}
			10 = {
				modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_LZ_mem.e300 }
				DA_LZ_remember.e300 = yes
			}
			10 = {
				modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_LZ_mem.e303 }
				DA_LZ_remember.e303 = yes
			}
			10 = {
				modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_LZ_mem.e330 }
				DA_LZ_remember.e330 = yes
			}
			10 = {
				modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_LZ_mem.e332 }

			}
		}
	}

# The empire a strange memory will bring (picked in the hidden roll; DA_LZ_remember_next in the button)
DA_LZ_pick_next_emp = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_emp.e1
	clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_emp.e2
	clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_emp.e116
	clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_emp.e118
	clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_emp.tchoken
	clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_emp.genie
	clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_emp.e223
	clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_emp.e271
	clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_emp.e300
	clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_emp.e303
	clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_emp.e330
	clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_emp.e332
	if = {
		limit = { DA_LZ_can_remember = yes }
		random_list = {
			10 = {

DA_LZ_remember_next = {

		hidden_effect = { clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_emp.e1 }
	}

# Depth for good (THE VOID, the Hermit, the Unmaking, the Rite of Zerat)
DA_LZ_add_depth = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_LZ_depth_tt.$amount$
	hidden_effect = { change_variable = { which = DA_LZ_extra_depth value = $amount$ } DA_LZ_refresh = yes }
}

# The counts the window, the tiles and the bands read: Depth, Clarity, their ratio and band, the empires
# remembered, the spires held and attuned, the tiles done by family. Frozen while the heritage is dormant.
DA_LZ_refresh = {
	if = {
		limit = { DA_RH_active_lizardfolk = yes }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_depth which = DA_LZ_extra_depth }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_mem_count value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_mem.e1 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_LZ_depth value = 3 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_LZ_mem_count value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_mem.e2 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_LZ_depth value = 3 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_LZ_mem_count value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_mem.e116 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_LZ_depth value = 2 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_LZ_mem_count value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_mem.e118 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_LZ_depth value = 2 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_LZ_mem_count value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_mem.tchoken }
			change_variable = { which = DA_LZ_depth value = 2 }
			change_variable = { which = DA_LZ_mem_count value = 1 }
		}

			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_mem.genie }

		}
		if = {
			limit = { 5650 = { owned_by = ROOT check_variable = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 3 } } NOT = { has_global_flag = gate_of_earth_revealed } }
			change_variable = { which = DA_LZ_depth value = -2 }	# The Mirror
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LZ_depth value = 0 } } }
			set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_depth value = 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_spires_held value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_spires_t2 value = 0 }

			limit = { 5921 = { owned_by = ROOT } }

		}

			limit = { 5921 = { owned_by = ROOT check_variable = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 2 } } }
			change_variable = { which = DA_LZ_spires_t2 value = 1 }
		}

			limit = { 5650 = { owned_by = ROOT } }
			change_variable = { which = DA_LZ_spires_held value = 1 }
		}

		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.LZ_Pro1 } change_variable = { which = DA_LZ_fam_prophecy value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.LZ_Pro2 } change_variable = { which = DA_LZ_fam_prophecy value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.LZ_Pro3 } change_variable = { which = DA_LZ_fam_prophecy value = 1 } }
	}
}

				set_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer_emp.e116
			}
			10 = {

				set_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer_emp.e118
			}
			10 = {

				set_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer_emp.tchoken
			}

				modifier = { factor = 0 OR = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_mem.genie has_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer_emp.genie } }

}

# One trait of the clutch, at random (hidden events only): echoes three times as likely, the likely ones twice
DA_LZ_pick_trait = {
	random_list = {
		10 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.gills }
			modifier = { factor = 3 DA_LZ_echo.gills = yes }
			modifier = { factor = 2 capital_scope = { has_port = yes } }
			set_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.gills
		}
		10 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.stone }
			modifier = { factor = 3 DA_LZ_echo.stone = yes }
			modifier = { factor = 2 calc_true_if = { all_owned_province = { OR = { has_terrain = mountain has_terrain = hills has_terrain = highlands } } amount = 5 } }
			set_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.stone
		}
		10 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.arms }
			modifier = { factor = 3 DA_LZ_echo.arms = yes }
			set_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.arms
		}
		10 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.eye }
			modifier = { factor = 3 DA_LZ_echo.eye = yes }
			set_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.eye
		}
		10 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.soft }
			modifier = { factor = 3 DA_LZ_echo.soft = yes }
			modifier = { factor = 2 any_owned_province = { province_has_center_of_trade_of_level = 1 } }
			set_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.soft
		}
		10 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.legs }
			modifier = { factor = 3 DA_LZ_echo.legs = yes }
			modifier = { factor = 2 any_owned_province = { OR = { has_terrain = grasslands has_terrain = steppe has_terrain = savannah has_terrain = farmlands } } }
			set_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.legs
		}
		10 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.hide }
			modifier = { factor = 3 DA_LZ_echo.hide = yes }
			modifier = { factor = 2 any_owned_province = { OR = { has_terrain = desert has_terrain = coastal_desert has_terrain = drylands has_terrain = glacier } } }
			set_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.hide
		}
		10 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.metal }
			modifier = { factor = 3 DA_LZ_echo.metal = yes }
			set_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.metal
		}
		10 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.bigeye }
			modifier = { factor = 3 DA_LZ_echo.bigeye = yes }
			set_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.bigeye
		}
		10 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.great }
			modifier = { factor = 3 DA_LZ_echo.great = yes }
			set_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.great
		}
		10 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.shard }
			modifier = { factor = 3 DA_LZ_echo.shard = yes }
			set_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.shard
		}
		10 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.naga }
			modifier = { factor = 3 DA_LZ_echo.naga = yes }
			set_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.naga
		}
		10 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.heat }
			set_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.heat
		}
		10 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.change }
			modifier = { factor = 3 DA_LZ_echo.change = yes }
			set_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.change
		}
		6 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.remember }
			modifier = { factor = 0 NOT = { DA_LZ_can_remember = yes NOT = { DA_LZ_band.lost = yes } } }
			set_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.remember
		}
	}
}
# The clutch's offer: DA_LZ_offer_n traits (three; four from the Brood Pools or with Medicine III; one more after
# the Changelings or a Fossil Clutch kept). Feed the Clutch rolls the same number again.
DA_LZ_clutch_roll = {
	DA_LZ_clear_offers = yes
	DA_LZ_pick_trait = yes
	DA_LZ_pick_trait = yes
	DA_LZ_pick_trait = yes
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_LZ_offer_n value = 4 } } DA_LZ_pick_trait = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_LZ_offer_n value = 5 } } DA_LZ_pick_trait = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_LZ_offer_n value = 6 } } DA_LZ_pick_trait = yes }
}
DA_LZ_hatch = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_offer_n value = 3 }
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { which = DA_LZ_level value = 4 } DA_completed.Medicine_3 = yes } }
		change_variable = { which = DA_LZ_offer_n value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_changeling }
		change_variable = { which = DA_LZ_offer_n value = 1 }
		clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_changeling
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_fossil_kept }
		change_variable = { which = DA_LZ_offer_n value = 1 }
		clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_fossil_kept
	}
	DA_LZ_clutch_roll = yes
	set_country_flag = DA_LZ_clutch_open
	clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_fed
	change_variable = { which = DA_LZ_clutches value = 1 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_clutch_in value = 20 }
}
# The trait of the new generation, chosen in the hall (the AI: the first offered)
DA_LZ_shift_gens = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_gen_12 which = DA_LZ_gen_11 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_gen_11 which = DA_LZ_gen_10 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_gen_10 which = DA_LZ_gen_9 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_gen_9 which = DA_LZ_gen_8 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_gen_8 which = DA_LZ_gen_7 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_gen_7 which = DA_LZ_gen_6 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_gen_6 which = DA_LZ_gen_5 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_gen_5 which = DA_LZ_gen_4 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_gen_4 which = DA_LZ_gen_3 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_gen_3 which = DA_LZ_gen_2 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_gen_2 which = DA_LZ_gen_1 }
}
DA_LZ_choose.gills = {
	if = {
		limit = { DA_LZ_echo.gills = yes }
		custom_tooltip = DA_LZ_choose_echo_tt.gills
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { DA_LZ_echo.gills = yes } }
		custom_tooltip = DA_LZ_choose_tt.gills
	}
	hidden_effect = {
		DA_LZ_clear_traits = yes
		if = {
			limit = { DA_LZ_echo.gills = yes }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_LZ_trait_gills_echo duration = 7300 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { DA_LZ_echo.gills = yes } }
			add_country_modifier = { name = DA_LZ_trait_gills duration = 7300 }
		}
		DA_LZ_shift_gens = yes
		set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_gen_1 value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_trait_now value = 1 }
		DA_LZ_clear_offers = yes
		clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_clutch_open
		DA_LZ_refresh = yes
	}
}

DA_LZ_ai_choose = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_chose
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.gills NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_chose } }
		set_country_flag = DA_LZ_chose
		DA_LZ_choose.gills = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.stone NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_chose } }
		set_country_flag = DA_LZ_chose
		DA_LZ_choose.stone = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.arms NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_chose } }
		set_country_flag = DA_LZ_chose
		DA_LZ_choose.arms = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.eye NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_chose } }
		set_country_flag = DA_LZ_chose
		DA_LZ_choose.eye = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.soft NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_chose } }
		set_country_flag = DA_LZ_chose
		DA_LZ_choose.soft = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.legs NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_chose } }
		set_country_flag = DA_LZ_chose
		DA_LZ_choose.legs = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.hide NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_chose } }
		set_country_flag = DA_LZ_chose
		DA_LZ_choose.hide = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.metal NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_chose } }
		set_country_flag = DA_LZ_chose
		DA_LZ_choose.metal = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.bigeye NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_chose } }
		set_country_flag = DA_LZ_chose
		DA_LZ_choose.bigeye = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.great NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_chose } }
		set_country_flag = DA_LZ_chose
		DA_LZ_choose.great = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.shard NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_chose } }
		set_country_flag = DA_LZ_chose
		DA_LZ_choose.shard = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.naga NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_chose } }
		set_country_flag = DA_LZ_chose
		DA_LZ_choose.naga = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.heat NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_chose } }
		set_country_flag = DA_LZ_chose
		DA_LZ_choose.heat = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.change NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_chose } }
		set_country_flag = DA_LZ_chose
		DA_LZ_choose.change = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_offer.remember NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_chose } }
		set_country_flag = DA_LZ_chose
		DA_LZ_choose.remember = yes
	}
	clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_chose
}
# Feed the Clutch: 10 Alchemical Essence, the offer rolled again (once a clutch)
DA_LZ_feed = {
	DA_EL_pay_essence = { amount = 10 }
	custom_tooltip = DA_LZ_feed_eff_tt
	hidden_effect = { set_country_flag = DA_LZ_fed country_event = { id = DA_LZ_event.14 } }
}
# The ancient traits (doc 70, section 6.3): a Fossil Clutch (20 years) or An Ancient Mutation (10 years), beside the
# generation's own trait. DA_LZ_ancient.<id> = { days = N }
DA_LZ_clear_ancient = {
	remove_country_modifier = DA_LZ_anc_golden
	remove_country_modifier = DA_LZ_anc_spire
	remove_country_modifier = DA_LZ_anc_araizary
	remove_country_modifier = DA_LZ_anc_desert
}
DA_LZ_ancient.golden = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_LZ_ancient_tt.golden
	hidden_effect = {
		DA_LZ_clear_ancient = yes
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_LZ_anc_golden duration = $days$ }
		DA_LZ_refresh = yes
	}
}
DA_LZ_ancient.spire = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_LZ_ancient_tt.spire
	hidden_effect = {
		DA_LZ_clear_ancient = yes
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_LZ_anc_spire duration = $days$ }
		DA_LZ_refresh = yes
	}
}
DA_LZ_ancient.araizary = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_LZ_ancient_tt.araizary
	hidden_effect = {
		DA_LZ_clear_ancient = yes
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_LZ_anc_araizary duration = $days$ }
		DA_LZ_refresh = yes
	}
}
DA_LZ_ancient.desert = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_LZ_ancient_tt.desert
	hidden_effect = {
		DA_LZ_clear_ancient = yes
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_LZ_anc_desert duration = $days$ }
		DA_LZ_refresh = yes
	}
}
DA_LZ_pick_ancient = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.golden
	clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.spire
	clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.araizary
	clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.desert
	random_list = {
		10 = { set_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.golden }
		10 = { set_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.spire }
		10 = { set_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.araizary }
		10 = { set_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.desert }
	}
}
DA_LZ_take_ancient = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.golden }
		DA_LZ_ancient.golden = { days = $days$ }
		hidden_effect = { clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.golden }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.spire }
		DA_LZ_ancient.spire = { days = $days$ }
		hidden_effect = { clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.spire }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.araizary }
		DA_LZ_ancient.araizary = { days = $days$ }
		hidden_effect = { clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.araizary }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.desert }
		DA_LZ_ancient.desert = { days = $days$ }
		hidden_effect = { clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_next_anc.desert }
	}
}

# Strange memories (doc 70, section 4): one picked in the hidden roll DA_LZ_event.30, by its weight
DA_LZ_strange = {
	random_list = {
		10 = {
			country_event = { id = DA_LZ_event.31 }
		}
		10 = {
			country_event = { id = DA_LZ_event.32 }
		}
		8 = {
			country_event = { id = DA_LZ_event.33 }
		}
		6 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 NOT = { employed_advisor = { category = ADM } } }
			modifier = { factor = 0 ai = yes }
			country_event = { id = DA_LZ_event.34 }
		}
		8 = {
			country_event = { id = DA_LZ_event.35 }
		}
		10 = {
			random_list = { 50 = { set_country_flag = DA_LZ_coin } 50 = { clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_coin } }
			country_event = { id = DA_LZ_event.36 }
		}
		10 = {
			country_event = { id = DA_LZ_event.37 }
		}
		10 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 NOT = { DA_LZ_can_remember = yes NOT = { DA_LZ_band.lost = yes } } }
			DA_LZ_pick_next_emp = yes
			country_event = { id = DA_LZ_event.38 }
		}
		8 = {
			DA_LZ_pick_ancient = yes
			country_event = { id = DA_LZ_event.39 }
		}
		2 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 NOT = { NOT = { has_global_flag = DA_LZ_tchazara_awake } } }
			modifier = { factor = 0 ai = yes }
			country_event = { id = DA_LZ_event.40 }
		}
	}
}
# A Falling Tchoken: the coin thrown in the hidden roll
DA_LZ_tchoken_coin = {
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_coin } add_prestige = 5 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_coin } } add_prestige = -5 }
	hidden_effect = { clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_coin }
}
# Tchazara remembers us: her legend wakes (le_rules.py: her trail)
DA_LZ_wake_tchazara = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_LZ_tchazara_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_global_flag = DA_LZ_tchazara_awake
		set_country_flag = DA_LZ_tchazara_trail
		5921 = { set_province_flag = DA_LZ_tchazara_here }
	}
}

# Monthly, for a country with the hall: the spires being attuned; the strange memories past Lucid
DA_LZ_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_attuning }
		clr_country_flag = DA_LZ_attuning
		if = {
			limit = { 5921 = { owned_by = ROOT has_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_LZ_attune_timer } } }
			5921 = {
				clr_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning
				change_variable = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 1 } }
					add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_LZ_spp_zhyani_1 duration = -1 }
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { 5921 = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_just_tier value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { 5921 = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 2 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_just_tier value = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { 5921 = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 3 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_just_tier value = 3 } }
			country_event = { id = DA_LZ_event.41 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 5921 = { has_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning NOT = { owned_by = ROOT } } }
			5921 = { clr_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning remove_province_modifier = DA_LZ_attune_timer }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 5921 = { owned_by = ROOT has_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning } }
			set_country_flag = DA_LZ_attuning
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 5650 = { owned_by = ROOT has_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_LZ_attune_timer } } }
			5650 = {
				clr_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning
				change_variable = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 1 }
			}
			if = { limit = { 5650 = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_just_tier value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { 5650 = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 2 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_just_tier value = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { 5650 = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 3 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_just_tier value = 3 } }
			country_event = { id = DA_LZ_event.42 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 5650 = { has_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning NOT = { owned_by = ROOT } } }
			5650 = { clr_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning remove_province_modifier = DA_LZ_attune_timer }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 5650 = { owned_by = ROOT has_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning } }
			set_country_flag = DA_LZ_attuning
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 5863 = { owned_by = ROOT has_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_LZ_attune_timer } } }
			5863 = {
				clr_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning
				change_variable = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 1 }
			}
			if = { limit = { 5863 = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_just_tier value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { 5863 = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 2 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_just_tier value = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { 5863 = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 3 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_just_tier value = 3 } }
			country_event = { id = DA_LZ_event.43 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 5863 = { has_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning NOT = { owned_by = ROOT } } }
			5863 = { clr_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning remove_province_modifier = DA_LZ_attune_timer }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 5863 = { owned_by = ROOT has_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning } }
			set_country_flag = DA_LZ_attuning
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 6032 = { owned_by = ROOT has_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_LZ_attune_timer } } }
			6032 = {
				clr_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning
				change_variable = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 1 } }
					add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_LZ_spp_arskitse_1 duration = -1 }
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { 6032 = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_just_tier value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { 6032 = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 2 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_just_tier value = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { 6032 = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 3 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_just_tier value = 3 } }
			country_event = { id = DA_LZ_event.44 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 6032 = { has_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning NOT = { owned_by = ROOT } } }
			6032 = { clr_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning remove_province_modifier = DA_LZ_attune_timer }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 6032 = { owned_by = ROOT has_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning } }
			set_country_flag = DA_LZ_attuning
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 5763 = { owned_by = ROOT has_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_LZ_attune_timer } } }
			5763 = {
				clr_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning
				change_variable = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 1 }
			}
			if = { limit = { 5763 = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_just_tier value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { 5763 = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 2 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_just_tier value = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { 5763 = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 3 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_just_tier value = 3 } }
			country_event = { id = DA_LZ_event.45 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 5763 = { has_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning NOT = { owned_by = ROOT } } }
			5763 = { clr_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning remove_province_modifier = DA_LZ_attune_timer }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 5763 = { owned_by = ROOT has_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning } }
			set_country_flag = DA_LZ_attuning
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 5971 = { owned_by = ROOT has_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_LZ_attune_timer } } }
			5971 = {
				clr_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning
				change_variable = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 1 }
			}
			if = { limit = { 5971 = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_just_tier value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { 5971 = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 2 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_just_tier value = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { 5971 = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 3 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_just_tier value = 3 } }
			country_event = { id = DA_LZ_event.46 }
			if = { limit = { 5971 = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 3 } } } country_event = { id = DA_LZ_event.50 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 5971 = { has_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning NOT = { owned_by = ROOT } } }
			5971 = { clr_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning remove_province_modifier = DA_LZ_attune_timer }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 5971 = { owned_by = ROOT has_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning } }
			set_country_flag = DA_LZ_attuning
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 5631 = { owned_by = ROOT has_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_LZ_attune_timer } } }
			5631 = {
				clr_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning
				change_variable = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 1 } }
					add_permanent_province_modifier = { name = DA_LZ_spp_izmeri_1 duration = -1 }
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { 5631 = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_just_tier value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { 5631 = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 2 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_just_tier value = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { 5631 = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 3 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_just_tier value = 3 } }
			country_event = { id = DA_LZ_event.47 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 5631 = { has_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning NOT = { owned_by = ROOT } } }
			5631 = { clr_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning remove_province_modifier = DA_LZ_attune_timer }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 5631 = { owned_by = ROOT has_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning } }
			set_country_flag = DA_LZ_attuning
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 6690 = { owned_by = ROOT has_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_LZ_attune_timer } } }
			6690 = {
				clr_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning
				change_variable = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 1 }
			}
			if = { limit = { 6690 = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_just_tier value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { 6690 = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 2 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_just_tier value = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { 6690 = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 3 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_just_tier value = 3 } }
			country_event = { id = DA_LZ_event.48 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 6690 = { has_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning NOT = { owned_by = ROOT } } }
			6690 = { clr_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning remove_province_modifier = DA_LZ_attune_timer }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 6690 = { owned_by = ROOT has_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning } }
			set_country_flag = DA_LZ_attuning
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 3740 = { owned_by = ROOT has_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_LZ_attune_timer } } }
			3740 = {
				clr_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning
				change_variable = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 1 }
			}
			if = { limit = { 3740 = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_just_tier value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { 3740 = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 2 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_just_tier value = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { 3740 = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_LZ_tier value = 3 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_just_tier value = 3 } }
			country_event = { id = DA_LZ_event.49 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 3740 = { has_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning NOT = { owned_by = ROOT } } }
			3740 = { clr_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning remove_province_modifier = DA_LZ_attune_timer }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { 3740 = { owned_by = ROOT has_province_flag = DA_LZ_attuning } }
			set_country_flag = DA_LZ_attuning
		}
		DA_LZ_refresh = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_RH_active_lizardfolk = yes check_variable = { which = DA_LZ_band value = 1 } }
		country_event = { id = DA_LZ_event.30 }
	}
}
# Yearly, for a country of the heritage with the hall: the countdowns, the clutch, the AI's works
DA_LZ_yearly = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_LZ_recite_in value = 1 } } change_variable = { which = DA_LZ_recite_in value = -1 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_LZ_clar_left value = 1 } } change_variable = { which = DA_LZ_clar_left value = -1 } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_LZ_level value = 2 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_LZ_clutch_in value = 1 } } change_variable = { which = DA_LZ_clutch_in value = -1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LZ_clutch_in value = 1 } } }
			country_event = { id = DA_LZ_event.11 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { ai = yes }
		DA_LZ_ai_yearly = yes
	}
	DA_LZ_refresh = yes
}
# The heritage turns dormant or active again (the racial pulse, DA_RH_sync_lizardfolk)
DA_LZ_sync = {
	DA_LZ_refresh = yes
}

# The AI (doc 70, section 14): the 1st, the 271st and its own empire at the start, the Hatchery free; a
# Recitation every five years; the first trait of each clutch; tier I of a spire it holds; a tile of the page
DA_LZ_ai_init = {
	set_country_flag = DA_LZ_ai_init
	set_country_flag = DA_LZ_built
	set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_level value = 2 }
	set_variable = { which = DA_LZ_clutch_in value = 1 }
	set_country_flag = DA_LZ_recited_once
	set_country_flag = DA_LZ_recited
	set_country_flag = DA_LZ_cd.recite
	set_country_flag = DA_LZ_mem.e1
	set_country_flag = DA_LZ_mem.e271
	if = { limit = { OR = { tag = L69 tag = L99 } } set_country_flag = DA_LZ_mem.e332 }
	if = { limit = { OR = { tag = L84 tag = L83 } } set_country_flag = DA_LZ_mem.genie }
	if = { limit = { OR = { tag = L68 } } set_country_flag = DA_LZ_mem.e330 }
	if = { limit = { OR = { tag = L95 } } set_country_flag = DA_LZ_mem.e2 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { tag = L68 tag = L69 tag = L83 tag = L84 tag = L95 tag = L99 } } primary_culture = ashhana_lizardfolk } set_country_flag = DA_LZ_mem.tchoken }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { OR = { tag = L68 tag = L69 tag = L83 tag = L84 tag = L95 tag = L99 } } NOT = { primary_culture = ashhana_lizardfolk } } set_country_flag = DA_LZ_mem.e300 }
	DA_LZ_refresh = yes
}
